Minimally Invasive Lifting
The Aptos Thread Lift
Aptos Thread Lifting at ISAAC Luxe uses specially engineered, absorbable threads to reposition sagging tissue — delivering long-lasting lift without general anaesthesia, large incisions, or extended downtime.

Threads made from Polylactic acid (PLA) and Polycaprolactone (PCL) are inserted beneath the skin via fine cannulas, lifting tissue into position immediately while triggering neocollagenesis — the body's natural collagen-rebuilding process — for continued improvement over up to 2 years.

How It Works

Immediate Repositioning

Threads lift sagging tissue into place the moment they’re placed.

Neocollagenesis

Stimulates the body’s own collagen production, continuing to firm skin over time.

What It Treats
Jowls Jawline Definition Cheek & Mid-Face Sagging Marionette Lines Neck Laxity

What to Expect
Your Treatment Journey
01

Consultation

A detailed consultation with our skin experts evaluates your skin elasticity, facial dynamics, and movement patterns to design your lift strategically.

02

The Procedure

The target area is numbed for comfort, fine cannulas are gently inserted, and threads are adjusted to lift tissues into a higher position — usually taking under an hour, with immediate contour improvement visible.

03

Aftercare

Most people can return to light daily activities within 24–48 hours.

04

Results Timeline

Results continue to improve over 2–3 months, with firmer skin and sharper contours developing over 8–12 weeks as collagen strengthens; results typically last 12–18 months.

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
